prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create a hand-drawn cinematic Korean webtoon storyboard contact sheet for "Today's Drawing, Tomorrow's Light", chapter 1. Use references: image 1 is the seven-year-old boy Seojin's identity and costume; image 2 is the exact Koriyo mascot shape used as a tiny bag keychain. Preserve boy's recognizable face, black straight fringe hair, pale yellow T shirt, beige shorts; small canvas school backpack with matching small gold star charm.
STYLE: refined ink-and-wash graphic novel, confident black pencil/brush contours, detailed realistic spaces and faces, muted sage / ochre / warm ivory, subtle paper grain, restrained expression, deep-focus layered Korean domestic spaces and carefully placed visual clues. Cinematic observational staging inspired by Bong Joon-ho's spatial storytelling, but an original warm child-friendly story, no horror, no violence, no copied movie shots.
LAYOUT CRITICAL: ONE landscape image, aspect 3:2, exactly FOUR equally sized rectangular panels in a perfect 2x2 grid. Top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Panels meet exactly at horizontal and vertical midlines. NO gutters, NO outer margin, NO borders, NO inset subpanels. Each quadrant is one complete distinct scene; we will crop the four quadrants for a scrolling website. NO text, captions, speech bubbles, letters, numbers or watermarks anywhere.
Top-left: wide static composition from inside a modest Korean apartment entryway, mother seen only as torso/hands kneeling to fasten a small yellow Koriyo keychain to the boy's backpack, boy looks back at her; doorway frames family routine, morning light, shoes at floor edge.
Top-right: precise close-up of the mother's hands fastening the yellow Koriyo keychain and a tiny five-point gold star charm on the worn canvas backpack, the boy's yellow shirt at edge. Prop is the focal point.
Bottom-left: overhead classroom desk, child's hands, crayons, a single landscape sheet neatly divided into THREE equal blank vertical columns, no writing. Orderly surrounding desks visible just at edge.
Bottom-right: profile medium-wide of boy at desk drawing the first column, rows of quiet classroom desks recede behind him, bag with keychain on chair. Warm daylight, focused face, no adult Seojin.
This is an illustrated story, not a photo collage and not a character sheet.

CHAPTER 2, Hwaseong's past and present, four landscape tableaux.
TOP LEFT: the boy's crayon-drawn oval on paper in close foreground transitions along its edge into textured fossil dinosaur eggs embedded in weathered reddish stone. Focus on fossil egg clusters at Hwaseong Gojung-ri, no complete dinosaur skeletons and no living dinosaurs. Subtle drawn-to-real ink wash transition within one coherent image.
TOP RIGHT: Yunggeolleung royal tomb landscape, a rounded grass burial mound, traditional stone lantern and stone figures amid a tall pine grove. Low child-height viewpoint, shafts of natural light, solemn peaceful detail. No palace, no Suwon fortress.
BOTTOM LEFT: Dongtan Lake Park, broad quiet water, gently curving planted promenade, contemporary residential towers in the far distance, tiny walking residents, warm late afternoon. Distinctive Korean urban lakeside in an airy wide shot, no sci-fi buildings.
BOTTOM RIGHT: intimate oblique closeup of a semiconductor wafer on a clean laboratory work surface, an adult researcher's gloved hand beside it, a monitor with abstract wordless analytical graphics in background suggesting AI work. No named company, no logos, no readable numbers. Blue reflections on wafer, warm ambient accents. No boy inside cleanroom.

Concept framing, do not invent readable signage.
TOP RIGHT: boy in profile at classroom desk, his hand holding a yellow crayon paused over the EMPTY RIGHTMOST THIRD of a three-column paper. The left two columns contain small fossil/tomb and city/lake/sea drawings. The single right third remains visibly blank. Classroom quiet, amber evening light.
BOTTOM LEFT: at child eye level, a small friendly Koriyo (exact yellow/orange reference design, star wand) emerges in a warm glow beside the canvas school backpack, with a small matching keychain remaining on the bag; surprised but smiling boy looks down. One clear magical event, restrained golden glow.
BOTTOM RIGHT: same boy with backpack and Koriyo entering one open train doorway at Dongtan underground platform. Clear modern Korean commuter train interior, GTX-A-inspired turquoise accents, platform screen door at edge, no train brand lettering. Side-on staging and perspective leading lines. No sky outside and no invented station text.

edits.prompt:
Edit ONLY the supplied four-panel comic sheet (image 1). Preserve the exact 1536x1024 2x2 equal-quadrant layout and same ink watercolor style. Images 2 and 3 are child identity and mascot reference. Do not add text.
Keep TOP LEFT tunnel reflection panel and BOTTOM RIGHT fisher worklamp panel essentially unchanged.
Correct TOP RIGHT: the boy and Koriyo viewed from behind are standing just OUTSIDE the future station doorway, looking over a largely UNLIT city in blue twilight with pale unfinished watercolor outlines. Remove the iconic observation tower on the hill and all recognizable Seoul/Busan landmarks. Use modest original Korean apartment silhouettes, trees, a remote coastal horizon. NO illuminated rows of street lamps or bright windows yet, only very dim ambient sky. There is no dystopia, ruin or disaster.
Correct BOTTOM LEFT: the SAME boy is now OUTSIDE on a pedestrian viewing terrace, NOT inside the train and NOT beside a train window frame. Keep his recognizable reference face and the clear close three-quarter crayon-drawing hand action, with a delicate short warm gold curved line traveling from crayon tip to ONE illuminated window in the nearby dim city. Rest of city still pale and dim. Keep Koriyo beside him. This is the FIRST light he draws; multiple city lights should not already be on.
Maintain the friendly observational cinematic framing. Do not change costume, hairstyle, age or mascot shape. No extra panels, no borders or gutters.
